I have resolved the issue where the MySQL backend used deprecated `"db"` and `"passwd"` keyword arguments.

### Summary of Changes
1. **[`django/db/backends/mysql/base.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0dj7ym55/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py#L200-L206)**: Updated `get_connection_params()` to use `"database"` and `"password"` instead of `"db"` and `"passwd"`.
2. **[`django/db/backends/mysql/client.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0dj7ym55/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py#L8-L15)**: Updated `settings_to_cmd_args_env()` to check for `"database"` in `OPTIONS` prior to falling back to `"db"`.
3. **[`tests/backends/mysql/tests.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0dj7ym55/tests/backends/mysql/tests.py#L93-L113)**: Added unit test `ConnectionParamsTests` to verify `get_connection_params()` returns `'database'` and `'password'` parameters.
4. **[`tests/dbshell/test_mysql.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-0dj7ym55/tests/dbshell/test_mysql.py#L71-L90)**: Added unit test `test_options_database` to verify `database` in `OPTIONS` is handled in `settings_to_cmd_args_env`.
